summary: Phase 2 (real email through Emergent-managed Resend) tested end-to-end against the preview URL, with pytest + Mongo checks and Playwright on the admin and public UI. When the provider had quota, every JRN-26..JRN-36 transactional path came back ACCEPTED with a Resend message id: CONTACT_ACK, NEWSLETTER_VERIFY, exactly one NEWSLETTER_WELCOME after confirming twice, booking confirmation, one CLIENT_WELCOME with no second one on a repeat booking, CLIENT_WELCOME for a client created by the admin in the agenda, SALON_NOTICE_BOOKING with all required fields, SALON_NOTICE_CONTACT, RESCHEDULED/CANCELLED, and REMINDER_24H/2H exactly once each. JRN-34 (job CANCELLED with reason + dashboard warning) and JRN-37 (marketing blocked FAILED with reason, notice shown, pending/suppressed subscribers not targeted) behave as specified. JRN-39: the scheduler processed a due job on its own. Phase-1 regression passed (23/23 pytest), and vitest passed (52/52). MAIN FINDING: the managed provider returns 429 [rate_limited] after about 10 emails in a ~10-minute sliding window (observed). The app has no throttling or 429-aware backoff, so normal bursts (3 emails per booking) quickly produce FAILED deliveries. Direct sends such as contact and newsletter emails are lost, and queued jobs burn all 4 attempts and fail permanently.

critical.issue: The managed Resend proxy returns HTTP 429 code 'rate_limited' ('email rate limit exceeded') after about 10 sends in about 10 minutes (seen twice: 10 ACCEPTED between 18:53 and 18:59:34, then every send rejected until about 19:06:40, then one slot freed). A 429 is treated as a generic FAILED. The worker keeps sending the whole batch (up to 50) back to back with no pause or stop-on-429, so all due jobs burn attempts together. Backoff is 2/4/8 min and maxAttempts is 4, which is shorter than the quota window, so jobs end up FAILED for good (seen: appt-init job FAILED after 4 attempts at 19:15:45). A single booking sends 3 emails at once (notice, welcome, confirmation), so about 3 bookings in 10 minutes exhausts the quota.

CONTACT_ACK, SALON_NOTICE_CONTACT, NEWSLETTER_VERIFY and NEWSLETTER_WELCOME are sent directly, not through the job queue, so they have no retry at all. If the provider returns 429 (it did for CONTACT_ACK/SALON_NOTICE_CONTACT at 18:59:34 and for NEWSLETTER_WELCOME of delivered+supp1 at about 19:06), the email is lost: the salon never gets the contact notice and the subscriber never gets the welcome.

minor.issue: Only reminder jobs check appointment status and version. A retried APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMATION, CLIENT_WELCOME or RESCHEDULED job for an appointment that has since been CANCELLED is still sent. Seen: the 'Cita confirmada (EQ-72F9L2)' job was re-attempted at 19:15:45 although that appointment was CANCELLED; it only failed because of the 429. A customer could get 'Cita confirmada' after 'Cita cancelada'.

With every recipient FAILED (managed sender blocks marketing), the campaign is still set to status COMPLETED with sentAtUtc set, and the UI shows a green 'COMPLETED' badge and the toast 'Campaña lanzada para 1 suscriptor(es)'. That looks as if it was sent. Recipient errorText is the generic 'Error al despachar en proveedor.' instead of the real reason. acceptedCount is correctly 0.

After a restart, the first interval tick is skipped. setTimeout(15s) runs the first tick, which sets the lease until = now + interval − 5s, but setInterval was started 15s earlier, so tick 2 fires about 10s before the lease expires. Seen: lastRunAt went 18:56:00 → 19:05:45, a 9m45s gap; after that it ran every 5 minutes (19:10:45, 19:15:45).
The NEWSLETTER_WELCOME subject is 'Bienvenida a la carta editorial de ESPACIO Q'; JRN-28 expects 'Te damos la bienvenida a ESPACIO Q'.
The raw manageToken is stored in plaintext in the job payload, which undermines storing only a hash of the manage token elsewhere.

ui_bugs.issue: The delivery errorMessage and providerMessageId are not passed to or rendered in the UI. The admin sees FAILED with no reason (rate_limited, blocked marketing, reserved domain), and cannot see the Resend message id. JRN-38 expects error text to be visible, and JRN-26 expects a message id.

Shows '95 correo(s) guardados en buzón local (no enviados: falta proveedor de email)' although the provider is configured. Those emails are SIMULATED_LOCAL because they went to reserved test domains, so the stated reason is wrong.
Feedback reads 'Prueba despachada a X (estado: FAILED)'; 'despachada' contradicts the FAILED status.

integration_issues.issue: The confirmation and welcome jobs stay PENDING until the next scheduler tick (up to 5–10 minutes); unlike the public booking route, the admin action does not process them immediately. After creation the agenda stays on today's date instead of the appointment's date.

issues: Uses the native browser date/time pickers instead of a shadcn calendar
No data-testid on the form fields
Campaign form, test email input, Enviar prueba/Enviar ahora, suppression input and contact form fields have no data-testid

action_items: Handle provider 429 rate_limited: pace sends (e.g. ≥1s between sends and a per-window budget), stop the batch on the first 429 and push remaining jobs' nextAttemptUtc out about 10 minutes without spending an attempt. Raise maxAttempts or lengthen backoff so retries outlast the quota window.
Route CONTACT_ACK, SALON_NOTICE_CONTACT, NEWSLETTER_VERIFY and NEWSLETTER_WELCOME through notificationJob (or re-enqueue them on FAILED) so they get retried.
Worker: for APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMATION, REQUEST_PENDING, RESCHEDULED and CLIENT_WELCOME, skip (CANCELLED) when the appointment is CANCELLED or its version is newer than the job's appointmentVer.
Show delivery errorMessage and providerMessageId in /admin/automatizaciones.
Fix the dashboard 'buzón local' warning text when the provider is configured (count only real local-only sends, or say 'dominio reservado para pruebas').
Campaign with 0 accepted / all FAILED: do not mark it COMPLETED with sentAtUtc; use a FAILED or BLOCKED status and show the real reason per recipient.
Scheduler: start setInterval after the first run, or make the lease shorter than interval − initial delay, so the second cycle is not skipped.
Optional: align the NEWSLETTER_WELCOME subject with JRN-28; avoid storing the raw manageToken in the job payload; add data-testids on the marketing, agenda and contact forms.
critical_code_review_comments: provider.ts: if an existing delivery is FAILED, the dedupKey path re-sends, which is fine; but recordFailure keeps the original subject and body on update, so there is no audit of attempts or timestamps per retry.
worker.ts processes up to 50 jobs per run with no inter-send delay; the booking route processes 5 jobs immediately. Both cause provider bursts.

launchCampaignAction calls processDueJobsAndCampaigns, which also processes all due transactional jobs inside an admin server action (seen at 19:07:17 retrying 13 jobs). This side effect adds latency and quota use.

seed_data_creation: Created TEST data: bookings with delivered+<label><run>@resend.dev and *@example.com emails (all cancelled except the admin-created 'TEST_ Admin Cliente' EQ-AQBSAT, 2026-12-22 17:15, Clara Mendoza, still CONFIRMED and needing manual cancel); subscribers delivered+nl0cc0b6@resend.dev (ACTIVE) and delivered+supp1@resend.dev (ACTIVE + manual suppression); campaign 'TEST_ Campaña QA' (COMPLETED, 0 accepted); contact messages from TEST_ Visitante / TEST_ UI Visitante. 12 of my own pending retry jobs were manually set CANCELLED to free provider quota. salonSettings.noticeEmail and contactEmail were left null (original values).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Provider quota is about 10 emails per ~10 min (sliding). Plan email-consuming tests in that budget: each new-client booking = 3 emails when noticeEmail is set, plus 1 on cancel during teardown. Use PHASE2_EXISTING_EMAIL=<an already-welcomed resend.dev email> to avoid the welcome email. conftest.py clears public rate-limit hits. Run single tests with -k. The scheduler lease is in schedulerLeases 'job-queue'.
rca of the issue: Rate-limit failures: the Emergent email proxy enforces a per-key send quota (429 rate_limited). dispatchEmailWithAudit maps it to FAILED; the worker throws, so the job is retried with 2/4/8-min backoff while the next batch blasts again, and the quota window (about 10 min) outlasts the retries, so jobs are exhausted. Repro: make 4 online bookings plus a contact form submission within 2 minutes with notice email set, then check emailDelivery errorMessage '[rate_limited] email rate limit exceeded'. Mitigation: global send pacer + 429-aware deferral without spending attempts, and queue all direct sends.
